def: a hole (as if for light), i.e. cavern; by analogy, a spring (of water)

occurrences.text: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.
Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter?

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
